page.layout: One printed title page, upside down on the scan, with a library stamp in the middle-left. Top block: a title in large type, rotated 180 degrees. Middle block: a large title word, a subtitle and a short line of small type. Central woodcut ornament. Bottom block: imprint in spaced capitals, rotated, with a date. No margins with text. The blue stamp "BIBLIOTHECA REGIA MONACENSIS" is a library stamp and is not transcribed.
page.notes: The page is printed upside down, so the top lines are read from the bottom. Much of the small type is too faint to read and is marked illegible. The stamp is a library stamp and is left out. Readings marked [?] are doubtful. The date at the foot is probably in Roman numerals, but I could not read it with confidence.
